title: CLO is getting slow
content:
CLO is getting slow while working on particle distance 5.

is there any way to speed up.

Regards,

NK

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: It is not recommended to work at a PD of 5. Even on very high powered computers.It is best to work on PD of 20 and then lower it to check fit and drape. But if you need to go to edit again go back to 20.I will only keep very small pattern pieces like pockets and cuffs at 5. Large pattern pieces should always be at 20 while editing
content_description: This webpage aims to provide solutions and tips for optimizing CLO performance when working with particle distance settings.
